item.title: Re: TICKY TAFFY TOWN (Seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
This feels pretty reminiscent of something like SCP-993 or SCP-2030 without really doing anything hugely new with the concept. It also feels like it relies really heavily on shock horror, particularly that of massive child death, and I would really urge you to not do that.

Beyond this: your actual pitch is too heavily summarised, which makes it really hard to tell how all the stuff fits together. E.g., you mention the 'children's show and candy are mysteriously causing disappearances' but there's not really any indication of how this works: is it like, people on the show disappear? People who watch it? How does the candy tie in?

There's talk of an exploration log in the middle of the central narrative which seems fine; but you mention that 'Addendums and follow up memos follow to round out the story' but I don't really have a feel for either a) what the core of the story is or b) how they round out the story; and I'm left feeling…not very enthused by any part of this.

The backstory of the show and candy can be summoned that a joint venture by a part of Wondertainment and Ambrose sought to make a kids show but funding was tight so they got dark money from a sarckic cult. There is a Hastur like entity in an alternate reality that is taking children.

The reason why the UIU handed it off was because one of the UIU members had their kid taken.

item.title: Re: TICKY TAFFY TOWN (Seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
This is actually a fun idea, as weird as I know that sounds. While there are a number of Kid-TV SCP's, this is just different enough from them that it could work.

1) You need to flesh it out a bit. There's just nothing really here; it's just a skeleton. To whom or what the sacrifice is to needs to be better defined. There is also an issue in how so many kids are killed on a regular basis without anyone finding out; even if you used nothing but runaways and orphans the murder toll would create curiosity at some point.

2) The UIU doesn't hand cases off to The Foundation without a good reason. Why did they do that this time?

It's an excellent start, it just needs some fleshing out.

item.title: TICKY TAFFY TOWN (Seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Page Layout: Standard SCP article

Elevator Pitch: A children’s show and candy are mysteriously causing disappearances. A research team sends a D-Class in to explore. To everyone’s shock a gruesome sacrifice takes place.

Central Narrative: UIU hands off investigation to Foundation. Trials are outlined. Common factors on child disappearances are identified. Standard Research protocols and memos leads to an exploration log. D-Class is thrust into a children’s television show and is witness to the slaughter of many children at the hands of an unknown entity. Addendums and follow up memos follow to round out the story.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: What if the Teletubbies wanted to eat your flesh?
